verdict.rationale: Framer has its own built-in AI agent, so it is fair to ask whether that agent can consume external MCP servers. However, the evidence only shows the reverse direction: external agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex connect into Framer, and Framer says it 'doesn't require a separate MCP server'. Nothing shows Framer's agent or editor plugging in third-party MCP servers to use their tools, and plugins are a different extension mechanism that does not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
